name: kettlebell-arm-bar
instructions:
1. In a side lying position, grasp a kettlebell with both hands and roll onto your back.
2. Press the kettlebell to full lockout using just one arm and then place your free hand out to the side of the body.
3. Bring the ipsilateral knee into flexion and maintain that position throughout the duration of the movement.
4. Rotate the knee in front of the body until it touches the floor. Keep your eyes on the kettlebell but allow the shoulder blade to move independently on the ribcage as the hips rotate.
5. Rotate the hips back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
